about: Consumables with a KNOWN body risk (DATA, read by client_mod/scripts/inventory.lua). The stay-fed reflex never uses them; the model's own consume may, and its reply says the risk. Keyed by item id. Dirty Water was removed 2026-10-26: its crash (BUGS L38) was the -nullrhi NULL Niagara spawn stored in LocalFX, fixed by client_mod/scripts/fxguard.lua (3 clean drinks live). Add a row here only for a reproduced crash whose mechanism is not fixed yet.
